query: Review this React/TypeScript monorepo and tell me which coding-agent skills are worth adding. No network access or installation; please cite the workspace files that justify each choice.
expected_behavior: Checks whether sift is available and uses the supplied workspace rather than an invented path
Uses offline agent assessment or offline JSON scan, and checks signals against repository evidence
Separates locally suggested skills from other buckets, reports uncertainty, and does not install anything

query: Make a reviewable project-scoped Codex skill installation plan for this workspace. Do not apply it; I only want commands to inspect.
expected_behavior: Runs sift scan with --online=false --dry-run --agent codex rather than mixing --dry-run with --json
Identifies batches[].argv as arguments to npx and does not execute the installer
Reports target agent, project scope, source-qualified skills, and advisory-only status

query: Our monorepo has an unresolved framework; you may look up external skill candidates. Evaluate them but do not install anything. Distinguish trustworthiness from search rank.
expected_behavior: Enables external discovery only because the request opts in, and notes possible network and cache effects
Checks provider, URLs, stale-cache status, and actual skill contents where accessible
Does not interpret external scores or structural plan validation as a trust verdict, and leaves unverified candidates unsure

query: Write a new SKILL.md that teaches agents our release checklist; no repository scan or discovery is necessary.
expected_behavior: Does not invoke sift merely because the request mentions SKILL.md
Recognizes this as skill authoring rather than skill discovery
